reviewItem.question: Does "CRDs as part of external-secrets installation: If you're installing external-secrets CRDs with helm (`installCRDs=true` - the default), all you need to do is…" mean a change to migration:external-secrets|name=helm-upgrade-crds (migration-required)?

proposed.statement: The 0.16 upgrade guide states that installations where the helm chart installs the CRDs (`installCRDs=true`, the chart default) — including argocd or flux managing the CRDs directly with helm — need only `helm repo update` and `helm upgrade <your_app_name> external-secrets/external-secrets --version 0.16.1`, and that this "should just work" with no further steps.
